card.name: Words just before a body-effect phrase
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs (the, by, to, caused, prevents, when) in health or science explanations, right before the text says what happens to the body, cells or tissue.

modes.label: Before an action on the body
modes.description: A word that leads into what a substance or cell does to the body, such as fighting infection or causing changes.
modes.example: help the<< body>> fight infections and other diseases

modes.label: Linking verbs of cause
modes.description: Verbs or connectors like caused, causing, prevents, or when that introduce a biological effect.
modes.example: This very cold liquid is sprayed or applied to the warts<< causing>> a small controlled area of frost bite.

modes.label: Toxic to or used by
modes.description: Short words like to or by after an adjective or verb, leading into who or what is affected.
modes.example: atrazine was toxic<< to>> some water-borne species in extremely low
